meta.title: WebP to JPG Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert WebP images to JPG format for maximum compatibility. Runs entirely in your browser.
formatAutoDetected: Format is auto-detected — no need to select manually
anyFormatDesc: Drop a PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, AVIF, or HEIC image and convert it to any supported output. You don't need to match the current page.
tooManyConversions: Too many conversions. Please wait a moment.
steps_webp-to-jpg_1Desc: Select a WebP image to convert. JPEG output ensures maximum compatibility with older software, social media platforms, and devices that don't support WebP.
steps_webp-to-jpg_2Desc: Adjust the output JPEG quality level. The default setting optimizes for a balance of visual quality and file size. Lower values produce smaller files.
steps_webp-to-jpg_3Desc: Click Convert to transform WebP to JPEG. The universal JPEG format ensures your image opens everywhere — your original WebP stays safe.
